summary: J.F., 66, reported overdue after a hike; a note left on his vehicle at the Lower Serpents Trail parking lot indicated hiking plans for Monday; a multi-day search with ~30 volunteers and a thermal-imaging drone located his body in rough terrain beyond the Devil's Kitchen rock formation.
notes: Body found Saturday 2020-06-27; coroner to determine cause of death. Victim identified as Jim Fuchs, 66, of Grand Junction; park staff started searching Thursday after a close friend reported him overdue from his Monday hike.
